failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Coordinator query at hop 2: 'Who directed and produced the film or work "We, the Normal"? What is their birth date?' - This is a natural-language yes/no style question bundling multiple targets (director, producer, birth date) rather than a well-formed entity-focused query.

failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 3 query 'We the Normal film director producer Arthur Penn Arthur Hiller' returned substantially the same documents as hop 1 (Arthur Penn, Arthur Hiller, We're All Normal and We Want Our Freedom). Neither hop 2 nor hop 3 retrieved a document about 'We, the Normal' despite explicit targeting.

failure_modes.name: Insufficient_Retrieved_Evidence
failure_modes.evidence: (i) Solver summary 1 explicitly names the missing evidence: 'A passage identifying the specific director and producer of "We, the Normal"' and 'The birth date(s) of that director and/or producer'. Summary 2 states: 'A passage identifying the specific film titled "We, the Normal"' and 'The name(s) of the director and producer of "We, the Normal"'. (ii) Hop 3 query targets this entity: 'We the Normal film director producer Arthur Penn Arthur Hiller'. Despite well-formed targeting across hops 2-3, no document about 'We, the Normal' was retrieved.

failure_modes.name: Missing_Evidence_Not_Specified
failure_modes.evidence: Summary 1 states: 'there is ambiguity about whether "Arthur Hiller Penn" in the claim refers to Arthur Penn or Arthur Hiller, as these are two distinct people with overlapping names' and requests 'Clarification of whether "Arthur Hiller Penn" refers to Arthur Penn, Arthur Hiller, or is an error'. No solver summary specifies what specific entity or document would resolve this ambiguity (e.g., a disambiguation page or authority explaining the name conflation).
